name: visiontrack-docs
description: Vercel build hook: renders the mkdocs-material docs into vercel_build/docs (served at /docs).

scripts.build: python3 -m pip install --quiet --disable-pip-version-check --target .pydeps 'mkdocs-material>=9.5' && PYTHONPATH=.pydeps python3 -m mkdocs build -d vercel_build/docs
